name: Paths Are Strictly Spread Ample
scope: Finite paths in their isometric binary embeddings, with constant coordinates suppressed.
statement: Every finite path is spread ample, and the containment is strict.
proof: Every pc-minor of an embedded path is a path, and its endpoints differ on all active coordinates, so it attains the largest possible diameter. The square $Q_2$ is spread ample but is not a path.
